name: Fear from making a gap (Taittirīya 2.7.1)
description: Fear arises for one who makes even a small gap or difference in that which is invisible, unexpressed and unsupported; it is the fear of the knower who does not reflect (2.7.1). Fearlessness is found in that support.

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.
